# CWI Homepages

> > Personal homepages and research materials from CWI (Centrum Wiskunde & Informatica), the Dutch national research institute for mathematics and computer science in Amsterdam.

This site hosts personal pages, course materials, and research outputs from CWI researchers including pioneers in Python development (Jack Jansen), multimedia web standards (SMIL), quantum computing, combinatorial optimization, and software analysis. CWI has been instrumental in developing web standards through W3C collaboration and advancing fundamental computer science research.

## Key Topics

- CWI Amsterdam
- Python and MacPython
- SMIL multimedia standards
- Quantum algorithms (QuSoft)
- Lattice-based cryptography
- Combinatorial optimization
- Software analysis and Rascal
- Semantic web and linked data
- Geometric functional analysis
- W3C web standards
- Interactive multimedia
- Graph theory
- Post-quantum cryptography

## Researcher Homepages

- [Alexander Schrijver = Lex Schrijver](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~lex): Alexander Schrijver's homepage: combinatorial optimization and graph theory
- [Jurgen J. Vinju](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~jurgenv): Jurgen Vinju's homepage: software analysis, Rascal, and metaprogramming at CWI
- [Māris Ozols](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~maris): Māris Ozols' homepage: quantum algorithms and information theory at QuSoft
- [Dick Bulterman](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~dcab): Dick Bulterman's homepage at CWI Distributed and Interactive Systems
- [Lynda Hardman Presentations](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~lynda/talks): Lynda Hardman's academic presentations on semantic web and multimedia
- [Hannes Mühleisen](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~hannes): Directory index with DuckDB presentations and conference materials

## Course Materials and Tutorials

- [Introduction to Lattice Algorithms and Lattice based Cryptography](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~dadush/teaching/lattices-2018): Dadush & Ducas course on lattice algorithms and post-quantum cryptography
- [Geometric Functional Analysis and its Applications](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~dadush/teaching/gafa-2019): Course materials by Dadush & Briet on geometric functional analysis at CWI
- [SMIL 2.0 -- Interactive Multimedia on the Web](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~media/SMIL/Tutorial/SMIL-4hr.html): Comprehensive SMIL 2.0 tutorial covering multimedia integration and timing
- [CWI's SMIL Tutorial](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~media/SMIL/Tutorial/abstract-nl.html): CWI tutorial on SMIL 2.0 for interactive multimedia on the web
- [Generating and viewing links in video](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~lynda/courses/USI15): Lynda Hardman course on video annotation and semantic web linking

## Python and MacPython

- [MacPython Website](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~jack/macpython): MacPython homepage: Python port for Apple Macintosh by Guido van Rossum
- [Jack's Macintosh software](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~jack/macsoftware.html): Jack Jansen's Macintosh software including Python ports and libraries
- [MacPython on Older Systems](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~jack/macpython/macpython-older.html): MacPython distribution for legacy Mac OS 9 and Carbon systems

## Multimedia and Web Standards

- [Muriel Jourdan on SMIL](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~lynda/www9/Jourdan.html): Muriel Jourdan on SMIL multimedia authoring and temporal synchronization

## Optional

- [Solving sudokus - Example continued](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~aeb/games/sudoku/solving9.html): Step-by-step sudoku solving tutorial with detailed example walkthrough
- [Directions and Hotel Information](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~dadush/workshop/discrepancy-ip/directions.html): Workshop logistics: directions to CWI Amsterdam and hotel recommendations
- [Chemical War Babies](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~jack/cwb/index.html): Amsterdam punk rock band page with history and music downloads
- [Uit de Sloot - Contact](https://homepages.cwi.nl/~jack/uds/en/contact.shtml): Contact and booking information for Uit de Sloot band in Amsterdam
